overview_description.description:
EduRev (short for Education Revolution) is an Indian educational technology company that operates an online learning platform providing courses, study material, and test preparation resources for school students and candidates preparing for competitive examinations.

It offers learning resources for both school education and major Indian competitive examinations such as JEE, NEET, GATE, CAT, and UPSC.

EduRev has received many accolades in a short span of time including the Best App Award by Google, Startup of the Year by TieCON, Edtech Startup of the Year by The Entrepreneur India, and has been selected in multiple prestigious Startup Programmes including Google Accelerator Programme, Facebook’s FB Start Programme, Amazon EdTech Startup Programme & others. 

EduRev has received venture funding from Y Combinator, Artiman Ventures and some prominent angel investors in India & US Silicon Valley. It was a part of the  Winter 2020 Batch of Y Combinator. 

EduRev was founded by Kunaal Satija and Hardik Dhamija, who had earlier worked on digital solutions for educational institutions together before launching EduRev as a dedicated online learning platform.
